narr: An early monsoonal moisture push occurred during the middle of May across Southern California. The heaviest activity occurred in the High Desert, where several reports of flooding were documented. Hot and humid conditions also occurred region-wide.
ev: Public report of traffic driving through several inches of moving water along Highway 395 at Desert Flower Road.

NWS storm survey conducted by WFO San Diego. Several sections of Mountain View Road were covered in mud as much as two feet deep with damage on the side pavement. El Mirage Raws recorded 1.23 inches of rain during the afternoon on May 21. Radar total estimates of 2-4 inches occurred in surrounding areas. Standing water along El Mirage Road with one home surrounded by water. A nearby dry lake bed was partially water logged.
